comment: Per-fixture Java-oracle counters (SesSnapOracle capture mode, run twice, byte-identical). ruleReach = trace endpoints whose drill-contact list survives the instanceof + layer-span + null-shape filters (the snap rule's INPUT surface); earlyOuts = rule-reach endpoints that returned via the <=0.5 arm; snapFired = non-null snap results. The snapFired=0 canary is EXPECTED (see writer.rs module docs: the inradius arm is unreachable through Trace.getNormalContacts' class-strict DrillItem acceptance) and is enforced loudly — a jar change that makes snapping live fails the compare. drillContacts counts Pin/Via drill rows in the SNAPLOG diagnostics (provider input rows, NOT endpoints); multiDrillEndpoints counts endpoints whose raw contact set holds >= 2 drills.
